items.title: Components of a Home Network (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Components of a Home Network' (PDF 17): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Home network ke kai ahem components (hisse) hote hain. Router network ke tamam devices ko jorta hai. Modem home network ko internet service provider (ISP, internet dene wali company) se jorta hai. Computers, laptops aur mobile phones network devices hain. Wired connections ke liye network cables istemal hoti hain. Wireless devices Wi-Fi signals se jurte hain.

blocks.prompt: Home network ke components ke naam aur kaam batayein.
blocks.explanation: Router: saare devices jorta hai. Modem: ISP se jorta hai. Computers, laptops, mobiles: network devices. Cables: wired connections. Wi-Fi signals: wireless devices ke liye.

items: Components: router (sab ko jorta), modem (ISP tak), devices (computer, laptop, mobile), cables, Wi-Fi.
